label: Finding-1
title: ai-found: Patch the Planet framing generalised to all finders
description: The claim says the flaws were found by researchers using frontier AI under OpenAI's Patch the Planet initiative. Calif's page places Calif under Patch the Planet; Wiz's blog and X thread never mention Patch the Planet, and Wiz credits Gemini 4 Argon most. The OOM root cause was first seen by a PHP core developer in 2024 without AI (Foundation blog). Reword to 'Calif, working under Patch the Planet, and Wiz both used AI models'.
